- Invoice.Date: "2023-02-24"
- Sender.VatId: "PL 748-000-55-14" (use the formatted NIP as present)
- Vat.Rate: "" (cannot infer numeric from "NP")

I will now produce the final JSON with those fields, preserving decimal places.
